//: Typecheck project for the Playwright browser-mock e2e suite (#3606). Before this existed, `e2e/**` belonged to NO project: tsconfig.app.json claims `src`, tsconfig.node.json the three config files, tsconfig.wdio.json `e2e-tauri/**` — the near-identical directory name being what made the hole easy to miss. This one IS referenced from tsconfig.json, deliberately: `tsc -b` is the only typecheck any gate runs (prek's `tsc` hook and _validate.yml's node-matrix `Typecheck (tsc -b)` step), so a project outside it is a project nothing checks. tsconfig.wdio.json was the last one outside it when this note was written and joined `tsc -b` in #3664; every tsconfig here is now reachable from tsconfig.json, so a new one that is not is a new hole. `noEmit` keeps this out of `vite build`'s bundle. Run standalone: `npm run typecheck:e2e`.
